parts.label: a
hints: Order the values first: $2.6, 2.9, 3.2, 3.7, 4.1$.

walkthrough.text:

$$\text{Ordered set: } \{2.6,\; 2.9,\; 3.2,\; 3.7,\; 4.1\} \implies \text{Median} = 3.2$$

$$Q_1 = \frac{2.6 + 2.9}{2} = 2.75,\quad Q_3 = \frac{3.7 + 4.1}{2} = 3.9$$
$$\text{IQR} = Q_3 - Q_1 = 3.9 - 2.75 = 1.15$$

$$Q_1 = 2.75,\quad Q_3 = 3.9 \implies \text{IQR} = 3.9 - 2.75 = 1.15$$

ai_rubric.observable: State median = 3.2.
Calculate IQR = 3.9 - 2.75 = 1.15.
